adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the Thor CLI option `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` from `lib/tasks/disqus.thor` and deletes the code that mapped it to a `category_id`, so `thor disqus:import -c ...` would now raise an unknown-option error. It also changes the importer’s initial topic creation from a simple “Permalink” raw post via `PostCreator` to `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, which imports remote content as raw HTML embeds (via the new `cook_method` path). That’s a real, diff-grounded breaking change to the task’s public CLI surface and behavior, though not inherently a code correctness defect if intentional.
